description: This file defines the SugarFieldRadioenum class, which extends SugarFieldBase, and is responsible for handling radio enum field types in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes a method to retrieve email template values based on options and input field values.

classes.name: SugarFieldRadioenum
classes.description: A class extending SugarFieldBase that handles radio enum field logic, including retrieving email template values based on options.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateValue
methods.description: Returns the display value for a given input field in email templates, based on options defined in app_list_strings. Falls back to returning the input if no matching display value is found.
